sloka: रक्तान् श्वेतान् सितामः चैव हरीमः चैव महा जवान् ॥५-६-३१॥
transliteration: raktān śvetān sitāmaḥ caiva harīmaḥ caiva mahā javān ॥5-6-31॥

translations.english: He saw horses of high speed in red, white and cream colours. He saw beautiful, wellbred elephants, which were not inferior to the enemy's. They were welltrained and had proved equal to Airavata (Indra's elephant) in battles. Resembling the thundering clouds, they were unassailable to the enemy in war and were trumpeting like a cluster of clouds.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--“गृल्म” का ग्रथं दल थवा टोली है । इसे दस्ता भी कह सकते हें । एसे प्रत्येक दल या दस्ते में & हाथी, & रथ, २७ घोड़े भ्रोर ४५ पैदल हुश्रा करते थे ।] राक्षसांश्च महाकायाच्नान्राप्रहरणोद्यतान्‌ । रक्ताञ्चेतान्सिः तांश्चापि हरींश्चापि महाजवान्‌
